dfNewFile = spark.read.format("parquet").load(sourcefile)
#nel file sono presenti duplicati per internalistitutionid con stato diverso e diversa data di creazione
#applico un filtro per prendere solo l'attivo più recente

#print(dtTmp.count())
dfTmp = dfNewFile.filter("state = 'ACTIVE'")

#print(dtTmp.count())
#dfAgg = dfTmp.groupBy("internalistitutionid", "product").agg(max("updatedat").alias("max_date"))

#dfTmp = dfTmp.join(dfAgg,(dfTmp["internalistitutionid"]==dfAgg["internalistitutionid"]) & (dfTmp["createdat"]== dfAgg["max_date"]) & (dfTmp["product"] == dfAgg["product"]))
#dfTmp = dfTmp.drop(dfAgg["internalistitutionid"]).drop(dfAgg["max_date"]).drop(dfAgg["product"])
#print(dtTmp.count())


# Define the window specification
windowSpec = Window.partitionBy("internalistitutionid").orderBy(col("updatedat").desc())


dfEnti = dfTmp.withColumn("_rank", row_number().over(windowSpec)) \
    .filter(col("_rank") == 1)\
    .select("internalistitutionid","institution.institutionType","institution.description", "institution.digitalAddress", "institution.address", "institution.originId", "institution.zipCode", "institution.istatCode", "institution.city", "institution.country", "institution.county", "institution.subUnitCode", "institution.subUnitType", "institution.paymentServiceProvider", "billing.vatnumber", "billing.publicservices", "institution.Category", "institution.rootParent")


dfEnti = dfEnti.withColumn('description',
    F.when(F.col('subUnitType').isNotNull(), F.concat_ws(' - ', F.col('rootParent.description'), F.col('description')))
        .otherwise(
            F.when(F.col('subUnitType').isNull(), F.col('description'))
            )
)

dfEnti = dfEnti.withColumn('originidpadre', F.when(F.col('subUnitType').isNotNull(), F.col('rootParent.originid')))

dfEnti = dfEnti.drop("rootParent")

dfContratti = dfTmp.withColumn("_rank", row_number().over(windowSpec)) \
    .filter(col("_rank") == 1) \
    .select("internalistitutionid", "product", "filename", "onboardingtokenid", "pricingplan", "updatedat", "createdat", "closedat", "year", "month", "daily","billing.recipientcode")

#actualTimeStamp = F.current_timestamp()
#dfEnti = dfEnti.withColumn("LastModified", actualTimeStamp)
#dfContratti = dfContratti.withColumn("LastModified", actualTimeStamp)
actualTimeStamp = datetime.now()
dfEnti = dfEnti.withColumn("LastModified",  F.lit(actualTimeStamp))
dfContratti = dfContratti.withColumn("LastModified",  F.lit(actualTimeStamp))

mergedDfEnti = tDeltaEnti.alias("target").merge(
    dfEnti.alias("source"),
    "target.internalistitutionid = source.internalistitutionid"
).whenMatchedUpdateAll().whenNotMatchedInsertAll().execute()

mergedDfContratti = tDeltaContratti.alias("target").merge(
    dfContratti.alias("source"),
    "target.internalistitutionid = source.internalistitutionid AND target.product = source.product"
).whenMatchedUpdateAll().whenNotMatchedInsertAll().execute()

watermarkTable =  DeltaTable.forName(spark, "fat_delta.watermark")

watermarkTable.update("TableName = 'enti'", {"LastModified": F.lit(actualTimeStamp)})
watermarkTable.update("TableName = 'contratti'", {"LastModified": F.lit(actualTimeStamp)})
